svg.text: outer box: no angles, glue on the whole surface · sanduku la nje: bila pembe, gundi eneo lote
Outer box, no angles needed: glue the outer bottom U under the row, then the outer end walls E to
both ends, then the outer long walls A over everything. Spray each part on the whole surface,
align the top edges and press well.
Sanduku la nje, halihitaji pembe: gundisha kitako cha nje U chini ya mstari, kisha kuta za mwisho
za nje E pande zote mbili, kisha kuta ndefu za nje A juu ya vyote. Nyunyiza kila kipande eneo
lote, linganisha kingo za juu na bonyeza vizuri.
Use spray adhesive only outdoors or with open windows, and cover the table with newspaper. Let the
box dry for a few hours before use.
Tumia gundi ya kunyunyiza nje tu au madirisha yakiwa wazi, na funika meza kwa magazeti. Acha
sanduku likauke kwa saa chache kabla ya kulitumia.
Kiswahili text: please have it checked locally · Tafadhali kagueni maandishi ya Kiswahili.
